worldcombat.skill.dragontail.summary: Sweep the tail across a broad fan in front, knocking every enemy caught in it away, costing them their target and driving them out of the fight; an opponent with a reserve is truly switched out, and the one right in front takes the heaviest blow.
worldcombat.skill.dragontail.use.0: Sweep a line of enemies away in front of you
worldcombat.skill.dragontail.use.1: Clear the enemies crowding you out of melee
worldcombat.skill.dragontail.use.2: Hit one sturdy target and send it away
worldcombat.skill.dragontail.description: Sweep a %3$s degree fan at %2$s blocks around yourself; the opponent right in front takes about %1$s Dragon contact damage and the others take a discount.
Anyone swept is knocked about %1$s blocks away from you and lifted %2$s blocks.
Anyone knocked away is marked Routed for %1$s seconds; while it lasts, anything closer than %2$s blocks is swept another %3$s blocks every 10 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.dragontail.high.on: High toss on: launch height x1.5, at the cost of x0.85 knock-away distance.
worldcombat.skill.dragontail.high.off: High toss off: knock-away x1.25 and lift x0.8, farther and flatter.
worldcombat.skill.dragontail.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.dragontail.growth.0: At level %1$s the sweep power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragontail.growth.1: At level %1$s the sweep power rises to %2$s and the knock-away reaches %3$s blocks.
On: launch height x1.5 but knock-away x0.85. Off: knock-away x1.25 and lift x0.8.
The companion only considers a tail sweep when an enemy is within this distance; farther targets go to the shared approach logic.
When aiming, the companion counts enemies within this half-angle around each candidate direction and picks the fullest fan.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to sweep. Off: it only does so when the enemy is already in reach.
world_combat.move.dragontail.text.hit: The tail sweep flung %1$s opponent(s) away
